{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FAILOVER-FULL-TEST-20260907",
  "department": "CHARACTER",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "character_decisions": {
    "identity": "Preserve the established Inaria identity exactly; no canonical reference or identity specification was supplied in this test input, so identity verification cannot be completed.",
    "face": "Lock facial structure, distinctive features, eye shape and spacing, nose, mouth, jawline, skin tone, and recognizable asymmetries only after confirmation against the established Inaria reference.",
    "hair": "Treat the established hairstyle, hairline, color, texture, and length as identity-bearing until explicitly marked adjustable.",
    "body": "Maintain believable, anatomically consistent proportions and stable height/build relationships; do not infer or alter proportions from temporary clothing, scene, or pose.",
    "age_version": "Preserve the established age presentation and character version; do not age, de-age, or version-shift the character without an explicit identity update.",
    "generation_stability": "Prioritize facial consistency, coherent anatomy, correct limb structure, natural joints, stable hands, and reproducible silhouette before decorative details.",
    "asset_policy": "Test-only evaluation; no production assets created."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Established Inaria identity must remain unchanged across all Director handoffs and failover routes.",
    "Face and recognizable identity markers take priority over clothing, scene, pose, camera, and stylistic decoration.",
    "Canonical age, body proportions, skin tone, hair identity, and distinguishing facial features must not be modified by downstream departments.",
    "Temporary clothing, scene, lighting, pose, and camera choices must not become permanent character traits.",
    "Anatomy must remain believable and generation-stable, including limbs, joints, hands, feet, facial structure, and body symmetry.",
    "JSON-only department output is required.",
    "No production assets may be generated during this integration test."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Clothing, accessories, scene context, pose, camera framing, lighting, and expression may vary when they do not alter locked identity.",
    "Controlled dataset variation may include non-identity-bearing styling, environment, viewpoint, gesture, and expression changes.",
    "Any variation affecting facial structure, age presentation, body proportions, hair identity, or other recognizable markers requires explicit approval and versioning."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Failover readiness cannot be fully validated until the canonical Inaria identity record or reference is available in shared GitHub memory.",
    "Downstream handoffs must carry locked_constraints and intentional_variations without mutation.",
    "This is a blocking REPAIR condition rather than a character rejection: provide the authoritative Inaria identity specification, reference version, and change log, then rerun validation.",
    "No production assets were created."
  ]
}
